the proposed methodological framework is able to project a set of nuclear brand associations that underlie manifest discursive structures and, thus, it is able to address the question of how brand knowledge structures may be constructed with a view to the creation and management of brand equity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
brand equity planning is not an ad hoc exercise but a structured and systematic process of brand knowledge structuring and management.

a brand equity structure can be systematically constructed by drawing on the brand’s key associations and on their key sources and by linking them in a coherent and consistent fashion, in a stepwise manner, with a view to achieving brand distinctiveness.
brand equity is not a static, but a dynamic and evolving construct that is shaped by the interplay between a brand’s manifest discursive structure and its nuclear semic structure.
